# Verb + 唔 + Verb？ · *Verb + m4 + Verb?*

**Meaning:** yes/no question (A-not-A) · **Level:** A1 · **Topic:** Asking questions

> ⚠️ **Draft — awaiting native-speaker review.** Spotted something unnatural? Please [open an issue](https://github.com/jyltsang/cantonlink-community/issues/new).

The most natural way to ask a yes/no question is to say the verb, then 唔, then the verb again: 去唔去 ('go not go'). For two-syllable words, repeat only the first syllable: 好唔好食. Answer by repeating the verb: 去 or 唔去.

**Written Chinese:** …嗎？ / 是否 — Written Chinese tends to use 嗎 or 是否.

## Examples

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **你去唔去呀？** |
| Jyutping | nei5 heoi3 m4 heoi3 aa3? |
| Yale | néih heui m̀h heui a? |
| Bopomofo | ㄋㄝㄧ⁵ ㄏㆤㄧ³ ㆬ⁴ ㄏㆤㄧ³ ㄚ³? |
| English | Are you going? |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **你係唔係老師呀？** |
| Jyutping | nei5 hai6 m4 hai6 lou5 si1 aa3? |
| Yale | néih haih m̀h haih lóuh sī a? |
| Bopomofo | ㄋㄝㄧ⁵ ㄏㄜㄧ⁶ ㆬ⁴ ㄏㄜㄧ⁶ ㄌㄛㄨ⁵ ㄙㄧ¹ ㄚ³? |
| English | Are you a teacher? |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **呢個好唔好食呀？** |
| Jyutping | ni1 go3 hou2 m4 hou2 sik6 aa3? |
| Yale | nī go hóu m̀h hóu sihk a? |
| Bopomofo | ㄋㄧ¹ ㄍㄛ³ ㄏㄛㄨ² ㆬ⁴ ㄏㄛㄨ² ㄙㄧㆶ⁶ ㄚ³? |
| English | Is this tasty? |
